codes.rule: See first; awareness makes action intelligent.
Upgrade your state before you judge your life.
Comfort keeps you asleep; truth wakes you up.
Ego wants to win; love wants to heal, build, serve.
Destiny is built through repeated choices.
How do I look? vs Who did I help? Ask the second first.
Become whole enough to carry greatness.
Upgrade the creator, the creation upgrades.
